next_round_constraints: Keep structure family centered on SEIRS; treat SEIR/SEIHR as secondary only if paired with a clear rationale to improve rolling behavior.
Prioritize observation_map = delayed_I; do not expand to composite observations (e.g., I+H) unless paired with a mechanism to prevent rolling degradation.
Constrain delay_weeks search tightly around 1 (primary) with only immediate neighbors (0 and 2) as ablations; deprioritize delay=3.

Prefer changes that target rolling robustness (stability across splits) over improving single validation fit; avoid adding compartments/complexity unless it demonstrably addresses rolling-only weaknesses.
observed_failure_modes: Delay sensitivity is high: delayed_I with 1 week is consistently better than 0, 2, or 3, suggesting the template is compensating for a systematic reporting/observation lag and misaligns when delay is off by ±1–2 weeks.

Rolling-only performance degrades when moving away from SEIRS+delayed_I: SEIR (delay=3) and SEIHR (I+H) show notably worse rolling behavior despite competitive single validation fit, indicating poorer temporal generalization under rolling splits.

Longer delays (2–3) appear to oversmooth/shift dynamics, hurting rolling fit; zero delay appears to react too quickly, also hurting rolling fit—consistent with a moderate-lag observation process rather than structural changes in transmission.

More complex observation/structure (e.g., I+H, adding H compartment) does not translate into better rolling performance here, implying the signal in this age band is adequately captured by the simpler SEIRS observation mapping plus a short delay.
feedback.proposer_instruction: For round 3, anchor proposals on SEIRS with observation_map=delayed_I and focus the delay on 1 week as the default. Include only small ablations at delay=0 and delay=2 to confirm sensitivity, but avoid delay=3. Do not introduce more complex structures (SEIHR) or composite observations (I+H) unless you can justify how they will improve rolling generalization; prior evidence suggests they overfit the single validation window and underperform on rolling splits. Emphasize templates/priors that improve stability across rolling windows while keeping complexity minimal.
